about.summary: Each point is one MNIST digit, encoded by a StyleGAN2 trained with an encoder on MNIST. 10,000 images: the MNIST test set, which the model did not see during training.

sections.title: Source
items: MNIST handwritten digits (LeCun et al.), test set; 28 × 28 px images converted to 32 × 32 px RGB.

sections.title: Model
items: StyleGAN2 trained with an encoder (after Adversarial Latent Autoencoders, Pidhorskyi et al. 2020): the discriminator is split into an encoder and a small classifier, and a consistency loss makes the encoder map a generated image back to the latent vector it was generated from.
Each image is encoded to one latent vector (one point per image), projected with UMAP; the UMAP parameters were not recorded.

sections.title: Colour options
items: label: the digit (0-9) from the MNIST annotations.
